digest.component_or_area: overlap judge / plan review advisory classifier
propositions: Overlap judge constructs RunRequest without operation-local output, retry, transport, or timeout bounds, inheriting generic 16K-token/600s/3-retry policy and causing multi-minute batched calls with malformed EOF responses.
A token cap alone does not prevent multiple structured generations; schema validation acts only after oversized payload exists; both are insufficient to contain runaway behavior.
Repair adds lowering-only per-request seams for structured_retries, transport_attempts, and timeout_s to RunRequest, applied before model construction in _effective_config.
Overlap judge requests explicit advisory budgets: 1,024 output tokens, one structured attempt, one transport attempt, and 60-second timeout; any bound hit returns exact all-candidate abstention.
Malformed/timeout/truncated overlap responses now degrade promptly to abstention within declared bounds, restoring compliance with story 9022 and ADR 0086.
Existing callers omitting request-local limits retain current defaults; valid batched verdicts preserve label-keyed mapping and aggregation behavior.
